tools.name: dpp_readiness_check
tools.description: Free informational EU Digital Product Passport readiness questionnaire; this cannot issue a passport or certify compliance. Returns a 0-100 score, gaps, and the dated obligation for the product category (battery passport is law from 18 Feb 2027; other categories are ESPR targets). Not legal advice.

category.description: battery_passport: EV, LMT (e-bike, e-scooter) or industrial battery over 2 kWh; battery_other: Other battery (portable, SLI, industrial up to 2 kWh); textiles: Textiles, apparel or footwear; iron_steel: Iron and steel; aluminium: Aluminium; tyres: Tyres; furniture: Furniture; mattresses: Mattresses; electronics: Electronics and ICT; toys: Toys; construction: Construction products; detergents: Detergents and cleaning products; other: Something else

sells_in_eu.description: Sold into the EU directly or via an importer. Default true.

unique_id.description: Each product (or model or batch) has a unique identifier, such as a GS1 GTIN with serial.

supplier_data.description: You can get material and substance data from your suppliers.

market_role.description: You know who places the product on the EU market (you, an importer or an EU representative).

footprint.description: You have carbon or environmental footprint data for the product.

data_host.description: You have a public web location where product data could be published behind a QR code.

data_owner.description: A named person owns product compliance data.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Free. Quotes without charging or authorizing payment the live x402 agent rail ($0.05 USDC on Base) and live human Stripe checkouts: $29 Starter Pack (100 generations, paid once) at https://authichain.com/checkout/starter and $299 EU DPP Readiness at https://authichain.com/checkout/dpp_readiness.

tools.name: negotiate
tools.description: Free, read-only, non-binding agent-to-agent capability/price-class quote. Returns available service, free vs separately authorized paid rail, and next step; never accepts terms, creates a commitment, transfers money, or calls an external service. This is NOT MCP initialize version negotiation.

service.description: Existing MCP service the agent wants to discuss.

mode.description: Non-binding quote only. Defaults to quote_only.

currency.description: Display denomination only; no FX transaction. Defaults to USD.

max_budget_usd.description: Optional caller budget ceiling; never authorizes a charge.

tools.name: query_provenance
tools.description: Free registry and published-pack lookup for an assetId / seal / QR token; use for discovery, not proof of authenticity. Reads matching rows from the canonical auth_seals registry when public Supabase configuration is available, and also resolves published packs. A registry match means registered only; it does not verify a signature or prove a physical item is genuine. Use verify_attestation for a published v0.1 JWS; verify_record is the separate reference-protocol verifier.

assetId.description: Seal, serial, or QR token identifier

tools.name: scan_living_qr
tools.description: Free. Read an existing Living QR presentation, not a QR generator or x402 purchase. Scan a stored Living QR. GET https://authichain.com/qron/r/{object_id} returns AuthiChain Verification Decision v1. This host verifies the signature. A missing id is presentation_not_found. Not an x402 payment endpoint, and it does not inspect a physical product.

object_id.description: Stored presentation id. Canonical form is qron:url: plus 8 hex characters.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: x402 paid seal-registry verification; use only after separate payment authorization, not for free lookup. Arguments that cannot be a seal UUID are HTTP 400 before payment. Empty arguments are unpaid HTTP 402. Paid calls are answered from the seal registry at $0.05 USDC on Base. For free verification use verify_record.

sealId.description: Required seal UUID. productId and serial are not registry keys.

tier.description: Signal tier. ping: registry existence only. verify (default): signature and validity baseline. evidence: the baseline plus a SHA-256 digest of the returned answer. The HTTP 402 quote states the exact price. No tier claims real-world authenticity.

tools.name: verify_attestation
tools.description: Free. Use when verifying a registry-published attestation, not a supplied offline protocol record. Fetch the exact published AuthiChain v0.1 JWS from the signed-record registry and pass it to the canonical edge-router verifier. Checks signature, issuer trust, durable revocation/status, expiry, and signed decision. Supply expectedObjectId to bind the record to a scanned object identifier. A valid signed claim alone does not prove physical authenticity.

assetId.description: Unique attestation ID or exact seal/product identifier

expectedObjectId.description: Optional independently observed object ID to compare with the signed subject

tools.name: verify_record
tools.description: Free. Use for a supplied signed protocol record or demonstration record, not published JWS issuer-status checks. Verify an AuthiChain signed provenance record with the open reference verifier. Pass id "polygon-anchor-1" for the published demonstration record, or pass your own record and anchor JSON. Returns verified, valid-unanchored, or invalid, plus whether the transaction carries the record hash. It does not inspect a physical product.

anchor.description: Anchor JSON: { recordHash, chain: "polygon:137", txHash }. Optional.
